description: This file defines the class 'planMilestonesCommands' which manages CRUD operations and view handling for project milestones within a test management tool. It interacts with milestone manager objects, handles validation, and logs audit events related to milestone lifecycle events.

classes.name: planMilestonesCommands
classes.description: A class responsible for handling milestone operations such as creating, editing, updating, and deleting milestones within a test plan context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection and milestone manager, setting UI element labels.

methods.name: setAuditContext
methods.description: Sets the audit context for logging purposes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Prepares a GUI object for creating a new milestone, with default values and labels.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares a GUI object for editing an existing milestone, localizing dates and setting descriptive labels.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Handles the creation of a milestone, including validation, date checks, and database insertion.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing milestone with validations and database update.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a milestone and logs the delete event, returning UI update info.
